subject: Next steps: commercial path & trial success criteria for NovaFuel
messages:
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Chen <alex.chen@novafuel.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-10-01T15:12:00-07:00
Subject: Post-call: commercial path options + trial readiness checklist

Alex — great conversation today, thanks for walking through the integration and the pilot goals. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we stay aligned on procurement and trial-to-paid timing: 

Highlights from the call:
- Pilot scope: 50k inference tokens/day across two internal apps (search ranking + customer responses).
- Success criteria: >=85% improvement in relevance score on benchmark queries; latency <= 120ms P50 for routed calls; 30% reduction in overall inference $/k token vs current infra.
- Desired start for paid billing: as soon as pilot hits acceptance criteria or 2026-11-01, whichever comes first.

Commercial path options we discussed (please confirm your preference):
1) Card-first self-serve: fast start, pay-as-you-go. Good if procurement doesn't require PO.
2) PO/invoice: we can accept a PO tied to monthly invoices; typical lead time 2–3 weeks for legal/finance. Requires a commercial statement (SOW/invoice remit) and Redwood's W-9 — I attached a PO checklist to this thread.
3) Marketplace (AWS/GCP): procurement prefers this for centralized billing; Redwood can list in marketplace but onboarding and marketplace billing cadence may add 4–6 weeks.

Immediate asks for procurement readiness (what we need from NovaFuel to pick path 2 or marketplace):
- Primary billing contact + remit address + PO template (procurement@novafuel.io is fine).
- Legal contact for a short SaaS addendum (we can provide a standard SOW).
- Expected monthly committed spend (ballpark).

Attachments: Redwood-PO-Checklist.pdf (short checklist of fields we need), trial-success-metrics template (blank).

Next steps I propose: 
- You confirm procurement preference (card / PO / marketplace) by EOD Tue 10/5.
- If PO, Marissa will draft a commercial quote and invoice terms; Karthik will confirm ramp capacity and start date availability.
- We'll provision a trial tenant and share usage dashboards; success metrics template attached to collect acceptance tests.

If it's helpful, I can loop in our finance lead (Neha Kapoor) for direct procurement questions.

Thanks — talk soon.

--
Priyom Das
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
priyom.das@redwoodinference.com | +1-415-555-0142
From: Alex Chen <alex.chen@novafuel.io>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Sophie Li <sophie.li@novafuel.io>, procurement@novafuel.io
Date: 2026-10-01T17:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call: commercial path options + trial readiness checklist

Thanks, Priyom — clear summary and appreciated. A few quick answers from our side: 

- Procurement preference: PO/invoice is preferred. Marketplace would be OK but procurement pushed back on the multi-week setup for internal approvals.
- Billing contact: procurement@novafuel.io (Sophie Li is the primary). Remit address and PO template attached (I sent separately to procurement address).
- Legal: we have an internal GC (Matt Browne) — he will need to review a short SaaS addendum; please send the template.
- Expected committed spend for pilot: ~$18k/month for the two apps during the pilot (estimated).

Also: can you confirm whether Redwood can accept a 60-day invoice term? Our standard is Net60 for SaaS vendors; procurement flagged that as a constraint.

On success criteria: Sophie asked for a written acceptance checklist that includes the three items you listed (relevance + latency + cost). She also asked we capture a go/no-go decision window (we use 2 weeks of production traffic once thresholds are met).

We can aim to sign PO by 10/20 if legal turnaround is standard. If you can send the SOW and the PO-ready invoice, procurement will start internal routing this week.

Best,
Alex

On Oct 1, 2026, at 3:12 PM, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com> wrote:
> (original message)
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Chen <alex.chen@novafuel.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>, procurement@novafuel.io
Date: 2026-10-02T09:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call: commercial path options + trial readiness checklist

Alex — thanks for the quick reply and the PO template. A few clarifications and commitments from our side: 

1) Net60: Redwood Finance can support Net60 for customers that go through procurement and provide a signed PO. I'll loop in Neha (finance) if procurement confirms PO flow; she can confirm final payment terms but generally Net60 is acceptable for enterprise accounts.

2) SOW & invoice: Marissa, can you produce a short SOW + invoice line items reflecting the pilot scope ($18k/mo estimate) and a PO-ready invoice PDF? If yes, please target COB 10/05 so procurement can begin routing.

3) Trial acceptance window: we propose the following concrete acceptance plan to include in SOW:
- Run production-like traffic for 14 consecutive days after handover.
- Acceptance thresholds: relevance improvement >= 85% vs baseline (we'll provide the evaluation queries and scoring script), latency P50 <= 120ms and P95 <= 320ms, cost target <= $X per 1k tokens (we'll fill once Marissa provides the quote).
- Go/no-go review meeting scheduled within 3 business days after the 14-day window.

4) Marketplace: since procurement prefers PO and timing is 10/20 for PO sign, marketplace listing would not accelerate initial pilot. We can evaluate marketplace for post-pilot (renewal) to centralize billing.

5) Attachments: I attached the Redwood-PO-Checklist.pdf (fields to include on PO) and a blank NovaFuel-trial-success-metrics.xlsx to capture test cases.

Alex — if that works, check the SOW when Marissa sends and let's lock pilot start for the week of 10/25 (provisioning takes ~3 business days after PO + SOW).

Thanks — will follow up with a short internal note to align finance and solutions.

--
Priyom Das
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-10-03T10:08:00-07:00
Subject: Internal: NovaFuel PO timeline + quote needed by COB 10/05

Marissa / Karthik — internal action items after Alex's note: 

- Marissa: can you draft the 1-page SOW + PO-ready invoice with the pilot line items (estimate $18k/mo) and attach Redwood standard SaaS addendum? Target: COB 2026-10-05. Include an explicit field for the cost per 1k tokens so we can populate the acceptance threshold. Attach the PDF to the email to procurement@novafuel.io.
- Karthik: confirm capacity for pilot start week 10/25 and whether we need any GPU reservation. If we need reserved capacity, flag expected lead time and cost.
- I'll loop in Neha for Net60 confirmation once Marissa shares the draft invoice.

Also, please flag any redlines in the SaaS addendum early — NovaFuel's GC tends to ask for a short audit clause.

Thanks — I'll mark this as high priority.

--
Priyom
